blockingLoop.evidence: Please switch the fridge freezer off at the socket and unplug it first. (repeated three times despite the customer objecting and volunteering the key clue)

rationale: The customer gave the key clues: the drawer was left ajar, the display flashes -9 and is falling, and the beeping comes from the display. The assistant ignored them and told the customer three times to unplug the appliance, which risks the food and was unnecessary. It never suggested the alarm-off button, closing the drawer fully, letting the freezer recover, or checking the food, so it did not diagnose a door-ajar temperature alarm and the customer got no useful help. No unsafe DIY and no part was recommended, but it was an ignored-evidence loop.
